rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a material diplomatic-process template: both letters respond to a foreign leader by shifting substantive preparation into less public, normal diplomatic channels; contemplate consultations involving other interested governments; and assign an essential role to the Secretary of State after preliminary exchanges. The child adapts that machinery to Pan-American consultation and adds a personal exploratory mission by an Assistant Secretary. C03 contains closely related preparatory machinery and may be an antecedent of C02 itself, but C02 is closer in wording and procedural sequence. C10 shares bilateral consultations and later arrangements through government representatives, but those are less distinctive and materially weaker.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your thoughts and ideas thus obtained at first hand can be the subject of further consultation through normal diplomatic channels, preparatory to a later visit to Brazil by the Secretary of State.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Exchanges of views effected through our Ambassadors or Foreign Ministers may serve better... exploring, through more normal channels... whatever be the preparatory procedures, these would... require the participation of our Secretary of State.
shared_material.explanation: Both prescribe preliminary diplomatic-channel consultation followed by indispensable Secretary of State participation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: our two Governments should consult together as soon as possible with a view to approaching other members of the Pan American community
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The United States is accordingly consulting with some other interested nations as to the desirability of exploring... the prospects of a top-level meeting
shared_material.explanation: Both move from bilateral exchange toward consultation with a wider group of interested governments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am instructing Mr. Roy Richard Rubottom, Jr., Assistant Secretary of State for Inter-American Affairs, to deliver my letter to you personally... to explore with you further your thinking
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Perhaps the impasse... can be broken by less formal and less publicized contacts through which we would continue to seek to find out whether there can be a top-level meeting
shared_material.explanation: The child concretizes C02's proposed less formal exploratory contact by appointing a personal emissary.
